questions: Should the shuffle order be the same across all columns of a given DataFrame, but independent across DataFrames, or should the same shuffle order be used for all DataFrames?
If a sublist contains duplicate column names, should the DataFrame have duplicate columns, or should duplicates be handled (e.g., ignored, raise error)?
Is the order of columns in each DataFrame required to match the order of elements in the corresponding sublist?
Should the function handle the case where a sublist is empty (i.e., no columns)? If so, what should the resulting DataFrame look like?
Is the random shuffle seeded or should it be truly random? If seeded, how should the seed be set (e.g., function argument, global seed)?
Are the column names required to be strings, or can they be any hashable type (e.g., integers, tuples)?
Should the function preserve the original order of POSSIBLE_VALUES in memory before shuffling, or is any permutation acceptable as long as columns share it?
If POSSIBLE_VALUES is empty, what should happen? Should an empty DataFrame be created, or should it raise an error?
